<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  xmlns:bpmndi="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/DI"
                  xmlns:dc="http://www.omg.org/spec/DD/20100524/DC"
                  xmlns:di="http://www.omg.org/spec/DD/20100524/DI"
                  xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
                  id="Definitions_EmployeePromotion"
                  targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/employee-development-promotion">
  <bpmn:process id="Process_EmployeePromotion" name="Employee Development and Promotion" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_DevelopmentNeed" name="Development need or career aspiration arises"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_IdentifyNeeds" name="Identify development needs or career aspirations"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CreatePlan" name="Create personal development plan"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_ParallelSplit" name="Split development activities"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_EnhanceSkills" name="Enhance skills"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ReceiveFeedback" name="Receive feedback and evaluation from supervisors"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_ParallelJoin" name="Join development activities"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_MilestonesReached" name="Milestones reached">
      <bpmn:noneEventDefinition/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ConsiderPromotion" name="Consider employee for promotion or new role"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_ReviewPerformance" name="Conduct formal performance review"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_ReviewApproved" name="Review approved?"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_FinalizePromotion" name="Finalize promotion with new responsibilities and compensation adjustments"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_Promoted" name="Employee promoted and transitions into new role"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_NotApproved" name="Promotion not approved"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_01" sourceRef="StartEvent_DevelopmentNeed" targetRef="Task_IdentifyNeeds"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_02" sourceRef="Task_IdentifyNeeds" targetRef="Task_CreatePlan"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_03" sourceRef="Task_CreatePlan" targetRef="Gateway_ParallelSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_04" sourceRef="Gateway_ParallelSplit" targetRef="Task_EnhanceSkills"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_05" sourceRef="Gateway_ParallelSplit" targetRef="Task_ReceiveFeedback"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_06" sourceRef="Task_EnhanceSkills" targetRef="Gateway_ParallelJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_07" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveFeedback" targetRef="Gateway_ParallelJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_08" sourceRef="Gateway_ParallelJoin" targetRef="Event_MilestonesReached"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_09" sourceRef="Event_MilestonesReached" targetRef="Task_ConsiderPromotion"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_10" sourceRef="Task_ConsiderPromotion" targetRef="Task_ReviewPerformance"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_11" sourceRef="Task_ReviewPerformance" targetRef="Gateway_ReviewApproved"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_12" name="Approved" sourceRef="Gateway_ReviewApproved" targetRef="Task_FinalizePromotion">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${approved}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_13" name="Not approved" sourceRef="Gateway_ReviewApproved" targetRef="EndEvent_NotApproved">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${!approved}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_14" sourceRef="Task_FinalizePromotion" targetRef="EndEvent_Promoted"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmndi:BPMNDiagram id="BPMNDiagram_EmployeePromotion">
    <bpmndi:BPMNPlane id="BPMNPlane_EmployeePromotion" bpmnElement="Process_EmployeePromotion">
      <bpmndi:BPMNShape id="StartEvent_DevelopmentNeed_di" bpmnElement="StartEvent_DevelopmentNeed">
        <dc:Bounds x="132" y="182" width="36" height="36"/>
      </bpmndi:BPMNShape>
      <bpmndi:BPMNShape id="Task_IdentifyNeeds_di" bpmnElement="Task_IdentifyNeeds">
        <dc:Bounds x="210" y="160" width="120" height="80"/>
      </bpmndi:BPMNShape>
      <bpmndi:BPMNShape id="Task_CreatePlan_di" bpmnElement="Task_CreatePlan">

      <bpmndi:BPMNShape id="Task_EnhanceSkills_di" bpmnElement="Task_EnhanceSkills">

      <bpmndi:BPMNShape id="Task_ReceiveFeedback_di" bpmnElement="Task_ReceiveFeedback">

      <bpmndi:BPMNShape id="Task_ReviewPerformance_di" bpmnElement="Task_ReviewPerformance">
        <dc:Bounds x="1120" y="160" width="120" height="80"/>
      </bpmndi:BPMNShape>
      <bpmndi:BPMNShape id="Gateway_ReviewApproved_di" bpmnElement="Gateway_ReviewApproved">
        <dc:Bounds x="1275" y="175" width="50" height="50"/>
      </bpmndi:BPMNShape>
      <bpmndi:BPMNShape id="Task_FinalizePromotion_di" bpmnElement="Task_FinalizePromotion">
        <dc:Bounds x="1360" y="160" width="120" height="80"/>
      </bpmndi:BPMNShape>
      <bpmndi:BPMNShape id="EndEvent_Promoted_di" bpmnElement="EndEvent_Promoted">

      </bpmndi:BPMNEdge>
      <bpmndi:BPMNEdge id="Flow_03_di" bpmnElement="Flow_03">

      </bpmndi:BPMNEdge>
      <bpmndi:BPMNEdge id="Flow_04_di" bpmnElement="Flow_04">

      </bpmndi:BPMNEdge>
      <bpmndi:BPMNEdge id="Flow_05_di" bpmnElement="Flow_05">

      </bpmndi:BPMNEdge>
      <bpmndi:BPMNEdge id="Flow_06_di" bpmnElement="Flow_06">
